items.detail: 原文抄自刊憲本（IRD 網站上嘅 PDF）。e-Legislation 嘅綜合本我開唔到，現行綜合文字要再自行核對。

blocks.text: (3) Division 1 of Part 2, except section 8, comes into operation on 1 January 2027. (4) Section 8 comes into operation immediately after the Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Automatic Exchange of Information) Ordinance 2026 (4 of 2026) comes into operation. (5) Division 2 of Part 2 comes into operation on 1 January 2028.

blocks.cite: s.50M “reporting crypto-asset service provider” — Ord. No. 8 of 2026
blocks.text: means an individual or entity that provides, as a business, a service of effectuating exchange transactions for or on behalf of customers, including by way of acting as a counterparty to, or as an intermediary of, the exchange transactions, or by making available a trading platform;

blocks.cite: s.50M “relevant crypto-asset”，排除項目 — Ord. No. 8 of 2026
blocks.text: (a) a central bank digital currency; (b) a specified electronic money product; or (c) a crypto-asset that, as adequately determined by a reporting crypto-asset service provider, cannot be used for payment or investment purposes;

blocks.cite: s.50M “reportable retail payment transaction” — Ord. No. 8 of 2026
blocks.text: means a transfer of relevant crypto-assets in consideration of goods or services for a value exceeding $390,000;

blocks.cite: s.50O HKRCASPs must register — Ord. No. 8 of 2026
blocks.text: (1) Despite section 50N(4), (5), (6), (7), (8) and (9), an HKRCASP must register with the Commissioner in accordance with subsection (2) and section 50V(1). (2) The registration must be made on or before 31 January of the calendar year following the calendar year in which the HKRCASP first meets any of the criteria specified in section 50N(1) and (2).
identify whether a crypto-asset user is a reportable user and whether a controlling person is a reportable person; … incorporate into those procedures the due diligence requirements in Schedule 17EA.

blocks.cite: Sch 17EA para 3 No reliance on tiebreaker rules — Ord. No. 8 of 2026
blocks.text: (a) cannot rely on the tiebreaker rules contained in any applicable tax arrangements to determine the user’s or controlling person’s jurisdiction of residence; and (b) must declare all of the user’s or controlling person’s jurisdictions of residence.

blocks.cite: s.80R(5) — Ord. No. 8 of 2026（用於 s.80R(1)(a)(ii)，即 s.50P 盡職審查）
blocks.text: (a) a fine at level 3; or (b) a fine of $1,000 multiplied by the number of the crypto-asset users and the controlling persons of the users who are the subjects of the offence, whichever is the higher.
For subsection (1)(a)(i), (ii) and (iii), engaging a service provider under section 50U(1) does not in itself constitute a reasonable excuse.
A person who commits an offence under subsection (2ZD) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3.

blocks.cite: Sch 17D new para 2B — Ord. No. 8 of 2026
blocks.text: (a) cannot rely on the tiebreaker rules contained in any applicable tax arrangements to determine the account holder’s or the controlling person’s jurisdiction of residence; and (b) must declare all of the account holder’s or controlling person’s jurisdictions of residence.

blocks.cite: Sch 17C new para 5A Low-value specified electronic money products — Ord. No. 8 of 2026
blocks.text: (a) it represents all specified electronic money products held for the benefit of a customer; and (b) the rolling average 90-day end-of-day aggregate account balance or value during any period of 90 consecutive days did not exceed $78,000 at any day during the calendar year or other appropriate reporting period.

blocks.cite: s.50C(1)，按 2016 年制定本（Ord. No. 22 of 2016）— https://www.ird.gov.hk/eng/pdf/aeoi/Inland%20Revenue%20(Amendment)%20(No.%203)%20Ordinance%202016_Eng.pdf
blocks.text: A reporting financial institution must furnish a return in accordance with a notice given by an assessor under subsection (2) and in compliance with subsections (4) and (5).
A person who commits an offence under subsection (2E) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3.

blocks.cite: 新 s.50AB(1)，Ord. No. 4 of 2026（2027 年 1 月 1 日起）
blocks.text: A reporting financial institution must register with the Commissioner in accordance with subsection (2).

blocks.cite: IRD：Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Automatic Exchange of Information) Ordinance 2026 頁，Enhancing record keeping requirements (Updated) — https://www.ird.gov.hk/eng/tax/aeoi/ordinance_2026.htm
blocks.text: If an entity is dissolved and, at any time during the six years before its dissolution, it was an RFI, every specified officer (i.e. every director of (or, if there was no director, every trustee of or every person who was responsible for the management of) the entity immediately before its dissolution) or the designated officer (i.e. one of the specified officers or a person who performed managerial functions in relation to the entity) (if any) of the entity must ensure that the relevant record keeping requirement is complied with despite the dissolution.

blocks.lead: 新（2026-11-18）：RFI 解散後嘅紀錄保存
blocks.text: IRD 嘅 Ord 4 頁（標示「Updated」）而家寫明，RFI 解散後嘅紀錄保存責任由 specified officer 或者 designated officer 承擔。呢個係 Ord. No. 8 of 2026 Part 3 對 Ord 4 嘅修訂，寫法同 CARF 頁一致。舊版只寫「every person who was a director (or a trustee or person responsible for the management, if there was no director)」。
其他：s.80R(4) 規定持續罪行每日另罰 $500。條文仲有 $5,000、$10,000、$20,000 乘以涉及人數（第 4 至 6 級）嘅較重罰則，觸發條件請睇 PDF 原文。

items: UNVERIFIED：e-Legislation Cap. 112 綜合本因為瀏覽器檢查開唔到，條文原文抄自 IRD 網站上嘅刊憲本同 2016 年制定本。
已核實（2026-11-15 更新）：CARF 最高罰則（公訴：第 6 級或 $20,000 × 涉及人數，加監禁 3 年）已經喺 Ord 8 s.80R(14) 原文核實。
UNVERIFIED：LegCo Brief、LSD 報告 LS26/2026 下載失敗，只見到搜尋摘要；IRD 會尋求批准簽署 CARF MCAA 一點未直接核實。第 4 級同第 6 級罰款嘅金額未從官方來源核實，題庫只寫級別。
題庫推論：Ord 4 新 s.80B(3A) 適用於改編後嘅 s.80B(1)(a)(ia)。按 2016 年制定本，原 (i) 係 s.50B(1) or (2)；2016 至 2026 年間有冇其他修訂未經綜合本核對（UNVERIFIED）。
題庫標「【UNVERIFIED／計劃】」嘅題目，答案來自諮詢文件嘅計劃日期，唔係法定日期。
UNVERIFIED：CARF 條例草案委員會報告搵唔到。
UNVERIFIED：OECD 2025 AEOI peer review 對 HK 嘅評級（搜尋摘要話係 On Track，原頁 403）。2022 年 on track 已經由 LegCo 報告核實。
計劃日期（未有法定依據）：2027 年 9 月開放登記、2028 年 6 月 CARF 報表到期、2029 年 6 月 CRS 2.0 報表等，以 IRD 將來嘅通知為準。IRD 2026 年 11 月簡介會簡報已寫明 CARF Portal「scheduled to be launched in September 2027」同報表「early June」，但仍然係計劃，唔係法定日期。
UNVERIFIED：首次 CARF 交換嘅月份。政府新聞稿只講 starting from 2028；PwC 新聞稿附錄寫 Sep 2028。
UNVERIFIED：遊戲角色「RO」唔係 Part 8A／8B 或 IRD 簡報入面嘅法定角色；IRD 一般查詢信嘅回覆期限、更正已交報表嘅程序、用戶拒絕提供 self-cert 嘅法定處理、family office 嘅分類，全部未核實。
知識地圖標「待補充」嘅來源位：change of circumstances、雙重申報規則嘅香港條文原文；amended CRS 數碼金融產品條文原文；reportable person 同報表限期嘅 OECD 位；多個知識點嘅業界評論。
UNVERIFIED：HKICPA 2026 年會只見 HKICPA LinkedIn 帖文（2026 年 6 月 10 日），未有官方紀要。

blocks.text: 本頁只供教育同學習參考，唔構成正式稅務或法律意見。實際個案請參考最新官方條文、IRD 指引，並諮詢專業顧問。資料截至 2026 年 11 月 18 日。

新增：知識地圖（19 個知識點，每個 4 類來源同掌握度）同遊戲中心（今晚一局、揀時長開一節、角色 × 行業、大案五幕、新例速遞、徽章）。之前 2026-11-18 嘅更新內容：IRD 網頁已經改寫成條例已制定；amended CRS 連結換成 crs_ordinance_2026.htm；Ord 4 部分加入 RFI 解散後紀錄保存（specified officer／designated officer）；題庫新增 3 題；近期動向加一行。IRD 網頁冇寫修訂日期，所以 11 月 17 至 18 日呢個更新時段係按每日比對推斷。
